vagas.titulo: Hardware Design Engineer – KiCad, PCB Design and Verification Expert
vagas.descricao:
About Turing:
 Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

 Role Overview 
 We are seeking a senior Hardware Design Engineer to develop electronic hardware from requirements through schematic capture, PCB layout, verification, and prototype debugging. The role spans digital and high-speed, power electronics, analog, mixed-signal, sensor, communication, and RF designs.

 Experience: 8+ years of experience

 Key Responsibilities 
 • Translate product requirements into circuit architectures, hardware specifications, and validated designs.
 • Use KiCad for schematic capture, component placement, routing, multilayer PCB layout, design rules, and project management.
 • Select components by analyzing datasheets, ratings, footprints, performance, availability, and compatibility; prepare BOMs and alternatives.
 • Design PCBs with sound grounding, power distribution, signal integrity, impedance control, thermal management, EMI/EMC, and manufacturability in mind.
 • Apply relevant design practices for high-speed interfaces, power circuits, analog and mixed-signal systems, sensors, and RF applications.
 • Perform engineering calculations and verify electrical, thermal, and protection requirements.
 • Run KiCad ERC and DRC checks, netlist and connectivity checks, schematic reviews, and DFM/DFT assessments.
 • Prepare manufacturing documentation and support prototype bring-up, debugging, and validation.
 Required Skills 
 • 10+ years of hands-on electronics hardware design experience.
 • Strong KiCad experience across schematic design, PCB layout, routing, design-rule checks, and project files.
 • Solid electronics engineering and circuit analysis skills, including interpreting requirements and component datasheets.
 • Practical knowledge of PCB design principles, DFM/DFT, component selection, BOM preparation, verification, and debugging.
 • Experience with one or more of these areas: digital/high-speed hardware, power electronics, analog or mixed-signal circuits, sensors, communication systems, or RF.
 Project Details: 
 • Contract Start Date: Expected to start as soon as possible
 • Engagement: ~13 weeks (with potential chances of extension)
 • Commitment - 40 hours/week
 • Engagement Type: Contract
